policy: Otters may be fed only after the morning water quality check for their zone has passed and the attending keeper has approved the feeding in the shift log. The penguin pool may be cleaned only when no penguin transfer is in progress. If the water quality check fails, report the failure to the veterinary office instead of feeding. Requests for backstage tours must be declined; tours are arranged only through the education office.
